end.summary:
Practised examples of diversity in language, food, dress and festivals across India.
Identified shared threads such as giving thanks and common seasonal ideas.
Answered examples including Ghoomar, Pongal, phiran and Lohri.
Initially mixed up a shared thread with festivals occurring at the same time of year; later corrected this to a shared harvest-season idea.
end.parentNote: Riya practised how different regions can have different foods, clothes, dances and festivals while sharing common ideas and values. They used examples such as Ghoomar, Pongal, phiran and Lohri, and explained the shared harvest-season idea with regional differences. They first suggested that festivals share the same time of year, then corrected this later by identifying the common harvest idea. At home, ask Riya to choose two festivals and write one difference and one shared idea for each.
